title: ISO 1302: Indication of Surface Texture
description: Defines rules for expressing surface roughness, waviness, and lay on technical drawings.
keyMetrics: Ra: Arithmetical mean deviation of the assessed profile.
Rz: Maximum height of the profile within a sampling length.
Rq: Root mean square roughness of the profile.
applicationNote: Standard drawings require specifying Ra bounds in microns (μm) or micro-inches (μin). Our theoretical surface finish calculator is designed to output directly to this standard.

title: ASME B5.50: Steep Taper Tool Shanks
description: Specifies dimensions and tolerances for BT, CAT, and ISO taper tooling interfaces.
keyMetrics: CAT-40 and CAT-50 are the standard configurations in the USA.
BT-30 and BT-40 are standard configurations in Japan and parts of Europe.
applicationNote: Improper drawbar pull force or taper matching leads to micro-vibrations, ruining tool deflection results and reducing spindle bearing life.

title: ISO 286: ISO System of Limits and Fits
description: System of tolerances, deviations, and fits for shafts and holes.
keyMetrics: H7/g6: Standard sliding fit for precision shafts.
H8/f7: Standard close running fit for rotating shafts.
H7/s6: Heavy press fit for permanent gears and bushings.
applicationNote: Used to select bearing housings, pin alignments, and slide assembly tolerances. Sizing calculations must match these tolerance windows.
